Safety starts with well-trained employees! At DHL Supply Chain in Weert, you’ll have the opportunity to coach colleagues, share your knowledge, and take workplace safety to the next level as an ITM Trainer. Wie zoeken we? You have strong communication skills, take initiative, and enjoy teaching others. You know how to motivate colleagues in a positive way and address unsafe behavior when necessary. With your practical mindset and sense of responsibility, you help make safety a natural part of everyday work. You also bring: MBO-level work and thinking ability. Experience in a logistics or operational environment. Practical experience with internal transport equipment. A valid reach truck and/or forklift certificate. Strong communication and coaching skills. Good knowledge of English and Dutch. Experience delivering training is an advantage. Wat bieden wij je? At DHL Supply Chain, you’ll have the opportunity to develop yourself while making a real impact on your colleagues’ growth. A full-time position of 40 hours per week. A gross monthly salary between €2,732.05 and €3,393.41, with opportunities to grow up to €4,055.98. Opportunities for training and personal development. A dynamic working environment where safety comes first. Career opportunities within Operations and Learning & Development. About DHL Supply Chain At DHL Supply Chain, people, safety, and development are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we build a safe working environment and strong logistics processes. Ready to share your knowledge and make a difference? Apply now for the ITM Trainer position at DHL Supply Chain in Weert! Functieomschrijving As an ITM Trainer, you are the specialist in internal transport equipment. You train and guide employees in using reach trucks, forklifts, electric pallet trucks (EPTs), and order-picking trucks (OPTs) safely and efficiently. Together with Team Leaders and Operations, you help create a safe working environment and continuously improve processes.

Delivering practical ITM training sessions. Coaching, guiding, and assessing employees. Conducting and recording skills assessments and certifications. Identifying safety risks and opportunities for improvement. Contributing to a strong safety and quality culture.
